program_name: Medicine and Surgery – Bari English Medical Curriculum (BEMC)
academic_year: [uncertain] 2025/2026 admission call; programme confirmed in the 2026/2027 international offer
academic_requirements: A secondary-school leaving diploma obtained in Italy, or a foreign qualification suitable for university entry in Italy.
Applicants with foreign qualifications must obtain a positive UNIBA qualification assessment through Apply online before the applicable international-student steps.
Admission is conditional on ranking within the available places after the national English-language medicine admission test (IMAT).
qualification_system_requirements: The foreign qualification must be based on at least 12 years of pre-university schooling.
Where the awarding country requires a separate academic-suitability or university-entry examination, evidence of passing that examination is required.
Qualifications obtained after fewer than 12 years require the compensatory conditions specified in the ministerial rules for international students.
language_requirements: The degree and admission test are in English.
For 2025/2026, non-EU applicants resident abroad and requiring a visa had to pass an Italian-language test unless they held a recognized CEFR B2-or-higher Italian certificate.
language_level: B2 (Italian, for the visa-applicant Italian-language condition or exemption in the 2025/2026 call)
accepted_language_evidence: A recognized Italian-language certificate at CEFR B2 or above for exemption from the Italian test applicable to non-EU visa applicants
No separate English certificate is stated as a general admission prerequisite in the programme call; listed language certificates are used in ranking tie-breaks
personal_preparation_assessment: Performance in the national English-language medicine admission test determines suitability and ranking; there is no separate programme interview.

entry_exam_or_test.name: IMAT / national admission test for Medicine and Surgery taught in English
entry_exam_or_test.provider: Italian Ministry of Universities and Research (MUR), administered through CINECA/Universitaly and participating universities
entry_exam_or_test.format: 60 multiple-choice questions with five answer options; 100 minutes; in person at an Italian or authorized foreign test centre
subjects: Reading skills and knowledge acquired in studies (4 questions)
entry_exam_or_test.minimum_score: 20/90 for EU and EU-equivalent candidates; more than 0 for non-EU candidates resident abroad competing in the reserved quota
entry_exam_or_test.notes: Scoring: +1.5 correct, -0.4 incorrect, 0 omitted. [uncertain] The 2026/2027 test date and format were not located in a programme-specific call.

selection_score_and_ranking: Maximum 90 points: +1.5 for each correct answer, -0.4 for each incorrect answer and 0 for an omitted answer. CINECA produces the single national ranking for EU/EU-equivalent applicants; UNIBA produces the ranking for non-EU applicants resident abroad. Ties are resolved by descending subject-section scores (biology, chemistry, physics/mathematics, logical reasoning, reading/general knowledge), then qualifying language certification, specified disability preference where applicable, and finally younger age.
